newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: RABO SECURITIES CUTS HEINEKEN TO A SELL.
newsitem.headline: RABO SECURITIES CUTS HEINEKEN TO A SELL.

text.p: it had downgraded Dutch brewer Heineken to a "sell" from a "buy"
The broker said it expected Heineken to achieve earnings
growth of only five percent in the first half of 1997 due to
lower volumes in three of its major markets -- the Netherlands,
Sales in the U.S. are expected to be five percent higher.
The company would not have derived much benefit from the
firm dollar as its exposure has been largely hedged, Rabo said.
Rabo Securities added it expected Heineken to underperform
the stock market in the next few months but it should show an
improvement in the second half of the year.
